newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, looking to trade sideways.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, looking to trade sideways.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were steady around midday on Tuesday, quoted around the London settlement as brokers forecast a further bout of sideways action.
Brent for March was quoted at $22.44/$22.65 per barrel after London rose just two cents to $22.54.
NYMEX March crude futures were last traded on ACCESS eight cents up from New York at $24.23 per barrel.
Brokers said there was little direction for Brent after the March contract failed to hold levels above $23.00. It now seems to have settled into a trading range around $22.50.

"I see a bit more sidways action until the APIs come out," one broker said. He was referring to the usual Tuesday release after New York trading of U.S. stock data from the American Petroleum Institute.
After two days of losses, March heating oil recovered slightly on ACCESS. The contract fell 0.88 cent in New York to 65.28 cents per gallon, but regained 0.27 on ACCESS to last trade at 65.55.
